environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on EC2 instance with static API key configured via environment variable. Key is set at deploy time and does not rotate. Service is exposed directly on port 8000 behind an NLB (layer 4, no inspection). No request body filtering or field-level authorization middleware.

config.api_key_rotation: none - static key set in /etc/environment at deploy
config.secrets_management: none - key hardcoded in systemd unit file
